categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Haojiang Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent linear drive systems industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent linear drive products. Its main business segments include intelligent home, smart medical care, intelligent office, and industrial transmission. The company offers products such as single motor drives, dual motor drives, tubular drives, lifting columns, controllers, and other accessories, serving various smart terminal applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages industrial internet technology to integrate multiple sensing and communication protocols for autonomous control of mechanical transmission devices. It employs vertical integration with self-developed key components, modular and automated production lines, and advanced manufacturing techniques including mold development, injection molding, and assembly. The intelligent linear drive systems combine mechanical drive units with intelligent control systems to achieve precise control over speed, synchronization, torque, and displacement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in sectors such as smart home (e.g., electric beds), smart medical care (e.g., electric medical beds, nursing beds), intelligent office (e.g., smart height-adjustable desks), and industrial transmission (e.g., automation in agriculture, construction, mining). The company serves both domestic and international markets, including North America, Central America, Europe, the Middle East, and Taiwan, with a focus on B2B clients and expanding into online sales platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Qingdao, Shandong Province. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in key international markets including the United States, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Thailand. The company is expanding its global footprint with a new production base in Thailand and trade headquarters in Hong Kong to enhance global market competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Haojiang occupies a midstream to upstream position in the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of intelligent linear drive systems and their core components. It controls key parts production such as motor drives, controllers, and molds, enabling vertical integration and reducing reliance on external suppliers. The company also manages procurement and quality control of raw materials and components to ensure product quality and cost efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on enhancing product performance, safety, energy efficiency, and user experience. It emphasizes modular, flexible, and intelligent control system development, including chip design and communication protocols. Strategic R&D projects target expanding product lines in industrial applications and smart office solutions, while also developing new platforms for scalable and customizable products. The company collaborates with universities and research institutes to maintain industry-leading technology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent linear drive products to domestic and international customers. The company employs a direct sales model supported by participation in trade shows, customer visits, and online sales channels such as Alibaba and JD.com. It also engages in OEM/ODM arrangements, especially in European and Middle Eastern markets, and derives additional income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the early entrants and leading technology innovators in the intelligent linear drive industry in China. It competes with firms like Zhejiang Jiechang Linear Drive Technology and Changzhou Kaidi Electric, which are expanding into its core markets. Qingdao Haojiang differentiates itself through vertical integration, advanced R&D capabilities, and a strong brand presence domestically and internationally. It holds multiple patents and industry certifications, positioning itself as a technology leader with competitive advantages in product customization and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 828 million, representing a 15.74% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 46.88 million, slightly declining by 0.58%. The company has steadily increased its R&D investment, accounting for around 6.67% of revenue in 2024. Total assets reached approximately RMB 1.49 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 1.04 billion. The company shows a growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao Haojiang emphasizes its integrated intelligent linear drive solutions that combine high thrust, durability, safety, and precise control tailored to diverse applications. Its vertical integration and modular production enable high-quality, cost-effective, and customizable products. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and patented technologies provide a competitive edge, delivering enhanced user experience, energy efficiency, and reliability. Its comprehensive service system ensures rapid response to global customers’ personalized needs, reinforcing its brand as a trusted leader in smart drive systems.
